Resolves #21130

🌿 *No example group can hide behind a three-dot menu any more.*

The examples section opens on an overview of every published group, and every group page keeps the whole index in reach: upright beside the cards on the desktop, as a sheet behind the crumb on a phone. The desktop control is the list, the design seat's target; OQ3 is settled on [D#20742](https://github.com/orgs/neomjs/discussions/20742#discussioncomment-19682816), and the switcher left at `ccdd24a5fa`.

Evidence: L3 (unit and e2e at 1440×900, 1366×768, 1280×720, 390×844 and 390×664 in both themes; the Look with two readers without session context) → L3 required (AC-2 to AC-12).

## What changes

- **`/examples` opens an overview:** the headline counts what the selected build publishes ("43 live examples in 16 groups" in production since #21240 added the export example), three groups to start with, the banded index, and every group's card by band. On a phone the start cards give way, so the index follows the build control.
- **`Portal.view.examples.GroupIndex`:** one component bound to the groups store (`Portal.store.ExampleGroups` of `Portal.model.ExampleGroup`), in three presentations: the overview, the upright index beside a group page's cards, and the crumb's sheet. Entries are links in the tab order; the open group carries `aria-current="page"`.
- **Counts by home record**, so they add up to the headline. A group that only borrows cards shows them in parentheses, explained under the index.
- **Phone, below 640 px:** a group page keeps a crumb whose group button opens the full index as a sheet. It takes focus, closes on Escape or a followed link, returns focus to its button, and the button carries `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`.
- **The desktop control:** the banded index stands upright beside the heading and the cards, stays in view while they scroll, and scrolls on its own once its groups need more than the viewport. No card is narrower than 410 px.

## Deltas from ticket
- `TabContainer` becomes `MainContainer`, a card layout over the overview and one page per group. Inactive pages stay mounted, so each keeps its scroll position.
- The overview replaces the Featured list. The `featured` flag loses its reader; dropping it from `examples.json` waits for the open catalog pull requests.
- `NewsTabOverflow.spec.mjs` used the examples tab bar as its bar that does not fit at 1920 px. The News bar now shows both states itself (1920 × 800 keeps the control, 1920 × 1080 withdraws it), and leaving News for Examples takes the control along (`c1d7c44364`).
- Scheduler and Gantt (#21247) joined after phase 2. At 16 groups the index needs more than 1280×720 holds, and the target's 21 groups need more still. The list arm therefore checks that the index box ends inside the viewport and scrolls on its own to its last group, instead of requiring every group above the fold. Its padding now counts inside its `max-height` (`border-box`); before, the box ran 32 px past the viewport.

## Test Evidence
- Unit at `ccdd24a5fa`: the full suite, 7,854 passed and 2 skipped.
- e2e at `ccdd24a5fa`: `ExamplesCatalogNL.spec.mjs` 21 of 21, `NewsTabOverflow.spec.mjs` and `LearnLinkRoutingNL.spec.mjs` 7 of 7.
- The Look: released and changed at 1440×900, 1280×720 and 390×844 ([comment](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/21241#issuecomment-6948334908)); the frames were committed at `ae1bf69d2f` and dropped at `9e9ef4de9a`.

## Post-Merge Validation
- [ ] After the next Pages rebuild, neomjs.com/examples opens on the overview and names every published group.
